div1.head: NOTES TO THE FIRST VOLUME.
div1.p: PAGE 2. Green Chafer, Scarabeus nobilis.
3. Guelder Rose, Viburnum opulus—a cultivated variety of the indigenous species.
7. Shards, Elytra.
10. Lady-bird, Coccinella—many species.
13. Snail, Ilelix.
15. Plover, Tringa vanellus.
17. Carp, Cyprinus carpio. Trout, Salmo fario. Perch, Perca fluviatilis. Bream, Cyprinus brama. Minnow, Cyprinus phoscinus. Roach, Cyprinus rutilus.
22. Otters, Mustela lutra. Badger, Ursus meles.
37. Heath, Erica—there are five British species.
38. Wasp, Vespa vulgaris. Hornet, Vespa crabro.

39. Hare-bell, Hyacinthus non scriptus. Broom, Spartium scoparium. Clover, Trifolium pratense. Wood-bine, Lonciera periclymenum. Hawthorn, Cralegus oxyucantha. Wild Rose, Rosa canina. Fox-glove, Digitalis purpurea. Indian Pink, Dianthus chinensis.
46. Hedge-hog, Erinaceus Europeus.
52. Pilewort, Ranuxculus ficaria. Daisy, Bellis perennis.
Pa. 56. Swallow, Hirundo rustica. Bat, Vespertilis murinus.

57. Nastursium, Tropaecolum majus.—This is one of the flowers which is said to have a sort of glory, or light halo of fire apparently surrounding it, of an evening in dry weather—a phenomenon first observed by one of the daughters of Linneaus. I once thought I saw it in the Summer of 1802.
68. Cocoa, Theobroma cacao. Bread fruit, Artocarpus incisa. Sugar cane, Saccharum officinarum. Indigo, Indigofera—many species. Ginger, Amomum zingiber.
69. Sensitive plant, Mimosa—many species.
71. Bird of Indian skies, Paradisea apoda.
72. Rook, Corous frugilegus. Hare, Lepus timidus. Pheasant, Phasiamus colchicus. Squirrel, Sciurus vulgaris. Dormouse, Mayoxus muscardinus. Marmot, Arctomis marmota.
73. Rat, Mus decumanus—brown rat. Mouse, Mus musculus.
84. Wood Strawberries, Fragaria vesea.
94. Yellow hellebore, Helleborus hyemalis. Snow-drop, Gulanthus nivalis. Orchis—many species.
95. Crocus, Crocus vernus. Hazle, Corylus avellana. Sallows, Salix carprea.
96. Violet, Viola odorata.
102. Carnation, Dianthus caryophyllus.
103. Aster chinensis. Poppy, Papaver somniferum. Sun-flower, Helianthus anorenus.
108. Lion, Felis leo. Leopard, Felis leopardus. Tyger, Felis tigris. Rattle-snake, Coluber horridus.
110. Snake, Coluber natrix, ringed Snake.
111. Viper, Coluber berus.
113. Field Cricket, Gryllus campestris.
Pa. 115. Locust, Gryllus migratorius.
116. Horse Ant, Formica Herculaneu. Black Ant, Formica omnivora.
119. Fox, Canis vulpes. Wild Cat, Felis caius. Weasel, Mustela vulgaris. Pole-cat, Mustela putorius. Martin cat, Mustela martes.
123. Kite, Falco milous. Sparrow-hawk, Falco nisus.
125. Tree-creeper, Corthia familiaris. Wood-pecker, Picus viridis.
131. Admirable Butterfly, Papilis atalanta.
132. Nettle Tortoise-shell, Papilis urtica.
149. Primrose, Primula vulgaris. Arum, Arum muculutum. Anemone, Anemone nemorosa.

150. Sorrel, Oxalis acelosella, Wood Sorrel. Hottonia—Hottonia palustris, Water Violet. Menyanthis—Menyanthis trifolia, Buck or Bog-bean. Lily of the valley, Convallaria majalis. Vinca major and minor, Perriwinkle. Orchis apifera & muscifera, bee and fly Orchis. Nightshade, Solanum dulcamara. Bryonia dioica, Brynny. Clematis vitulba.

151. Foxglove, Digitalis purpurea. Mullcin, Verbuscum thupsus. Galium—many species. Willow-herb, Epilohium—several species. Arundo, Reed—many species. Nymphea lutea, yellow Water Lily. Papaver sumniferum, Poppy. Corn-flower, Centaurea cyanus.
171. Wood-lark, Lauda arborea. Linnet, Tringilla linota. Thrush, Turdus musicus. Blackbird, Turdus merula. Nightingale, Motacilla luscinia. Robin, Motacilla rubecula.

177. Fragaria vesca, Strawberry. Lilac, Syringa vulgaris. Laburnum, Cylisus Laburnum. Clove pink, Dianthus—many species. Damask rose, Rosa damas
cena. Peach, Smygdalus persica. Raspberries, Rubus idaeus.
Pa. 180. Cricket, Gryllus domesticus.
187. Spanish Chesnut, Fagus castanea.
188. Olive-tree, Olea europaea. Ground Ivy, Glecoma hederacea. Orchis maculuta, and others.
190. Lychnis dioica. Mullein, Verbascum thapsus. Bugloss, Lycopsis arvensis.
191. Ring-dove, Columbo palambus. Stock-dove, Columbo oenas.
div1.head: END OF THE FIRST VOLUME.
